$comment: What the seed p4-base holds beyond its workspace, person and projects (the specification's Jobs and scenarios), read by Loam's runner, kernel/scenarios/seeds.ts, which names no app itself. Each app is loaded from its own source (dir, manifest, module, relative to endpoints/loam); console is the runner's fixture app. Each document is written to the store before the kernel starts, so its id is fixed; each call runs after sign-in; each check is what the seed's own test asserts.
